expected.notes: JUDGMENT CALL: the ITAD names (ERI, Ingram Micro, Sage Sustainable Electronics, Sims Recycling Solutions) compete with HPE Financial Services, an adjacency -- not the document's primary enterprise IT infrastructure market.
